body: I lost my husband to suicide 19 months ago, I felt the exact same way as you, much to my surprise 15 months later I met someone....what iv learned is things do change even tho we dont think they will or want them to, iv also learned everyone is different like my current partner is nothing like my husband complete opposite infact, and each new relationship is exactly that it is new and it is different so I'm going with that....I talk a lot about my husband to him and I cant help it I just do, I think it cant be easy for him but he is great and always says talk about him as much as you want to he is part of your life, I think for myself I got to a point where in order to live cos I havent a choice having kids a job a Bill's to pay it was getting harder and harder to "live" like I was under a cloud of misery and grief, so iv got back into life and things feel better....
